claim: Tito Bustillo cave is open 4 March to 30 October 2026, Wednesday to Sunday, first tour 10:15 and last tour 17:00, closed Mondays/Tuesdays and 8-9 August, with 15 visitors per slot and 150/day cap.
quote: Open from 4th March to 30th October 2026. Wednesdays to Sundays, from 10:15 h. (first tour) to 17:00 h. (last tour). Closed Mondays, Tuesdays, 8-9 August. Maximum 15 participants per slot, 150 per day.

claim: Tito Bustillo general admission is 4.14 EUR (reduced 2.12 EUR) with free entry on Wednesdays; tickets for visits from 1 July 2026 go on sale 1 April 2026.
quote: General admission is €4.14, and reduced admission is €2.12. Entrance is free on Wednesdays. Tickets to visit the cave from July 1 will go on sale on April 1, 2026.

claim: Guided tours inside Tito Bustillo cave are conducted only in Spanish; English audio guides and a QR-code English tour are provided as alternatives, and the on-site Cave Art Centre museum has bilingual Spanish/English displays.
quote: Guided visits are only in Spanish ... visitors are offered two audios in English ... a QR code outside before the bridge ... links to a tour in English ... modern museum with lots of audiovisual and interactive displays and with information in both Spanish and English.

claim: Visitors must arrive at the Centro de Arte Rupestre reception desk at least 30 minutes before their cave time slot or they lose entry; the centre sits about 300 m from the cave entrance and serves as the orientation museum and backup if cave tickets are sold out.
quote: Visitors must arrive at the reception desk at least 30 minutes before their scheduled visit time to confirm entry, as failure to do so means losing the right to enter the cave.

claim: The 'Roman' bridge of Cangas de Onís is in fact a 14th-century medieval bridge built under Alfonso XI of Castile spanning the Sella; a replica of the Victory Cross was hung from its central arch in 1939 after the Virgin of Covadonga returned from Paris.
quote: built in the times of King Alfonso XI of Castile in the 14th century ... One of the most iconic elements of the bridge is the large Victoria Cross that hangs from its central arch ... installed in 1939 when the Virgin of Covadonga returned from Paris.

claim: The Iglesia de la Santa Cruz in Cangas de Onís is an 8th-century pre-Romanesque royal foundation, consecrated 27 October 737 by king Favila, that once held Pelayo's Cruz de la Victoria and was rebuilt in 1632 and again in 1950 after Civil War destruction.
quote: here were consecrated altars to Christ by the priest Asterion on the day 300 of the year ... era 775, corresponding to October 27, 737 ... many modifications (in 1632 and in 1950 after destruction during the Spanish Civil War).

claim: The Santa Cruz crypt encloses a Neolithic/Bronze-age dolmen with engraved orthostats; visits are run via the Cangas de Onís tourist office, cost 2 EUR, last about 10-15 minutes, are closed Mondays and Tuesdays with last entry at 13:00, and guided slots run during Easter and summer.
quote: closed on Mondays and Tuesdays ... last entry is at 1:00 PM ... cost of entry is two euros ... Guided visits are available during Easter week and summer ... reservation at the Tourist Office of Cangas de Onís is necessary.

claim: The Covadonga sanctuary complex 10 km from Cangas de Onís bundles the pink neo-Romanesque Basilica (1877-1901), the Santa Cueva chapel above a waterfall housing the tombs of Pelayo and other Asturian royalty, the Pelayo monument, and a small museum; visits are free and open daily roughly 08:30-21:30 outside Mass.
quote: comprises the Holy Cave, Basilica, Covadonga Museum, San Fernando Collegiate Church, and Monument to King Pelayo ... You can visit it daily from 8:30 to 21:30, except on worshiping hours ... no entrance fee to enter the Holy Cave or the Basilica.

claim: Tito Bustillo is part of the UNESCO 'Cave Art of Northern Spain' inscription and tickets sell out fast in high season; Mondays and Tuesdays are closed and booking weeks ahead online is strongly advised.
quote: Cueva de Tito Bustillo ... UNESCO-listed Palaeolithic cave art ... book well in advance ... closed Mondays and Tuesdays.
